answer: A rookie must stake fifty tokens into a personal vault and register a pulse signature at harbor intake. The registrar agent inspects this pulse signature when the rookie submits the receipt to verify the vault balance. If the check fails or duplicates a clone ID, the system slashes the entire fifty-token deposit instantly. The per-session revenue is set to twelve tokens. Since twelve is less than fifty, every extra clone attempt ends thirty-eight tokens in the red. The harbor gate rejects the transaction immediately, locking the attacker out while the vault drains the bond.
